summary: Master the art of job analysis and evaluation with our intensive training course. Unlock the potential of your organization's workforce and drive success.
lede: Job evaluation training shows HR and compensation professionals how to assess roles and build structured grades and pay ranges. It covers gathering role information through structured interviews and questionnaires, writing job descriptions, and comparing roles with ranking and point-factor methods. Participants also practice translating evaluation scores into salary grades and reviewing internal equity across roles.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the structural integrity and fairness of the organizational hierarchy.
audience: Organizational Development Specialists focused on role clarity
modules: Data Collection and Job Analysis Tools
The Hay Method and Mercer IPE
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of Human Resource management principles. Experience in recruitment, payroll, or general HR administration is recommended but not mandatory. Access to a laptop with spreadsheet software (e.g., Excel) is required for the quantitative exercises.
